in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Rider of the Horse
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hori हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Hori is the name of a warrior god riding a horse. He is known for his courage, strength, and victory over evil.
